subject: Decision criteria & stakeholder mapping — latency/cost/SLA follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Decision criteria & stakeholder mapping — latency/cost/SLA follow-up

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can map stakeholders and align next steps.

Call recap (short):
- Use case: real-time personalized guidance in the Finova advisor app (web + mobile).
- Key decision areas: latency (user experience), unit economics (token cost / monthly run rate), and deployment model (Dedicated vs Private).
- Procurement + security will want SOC 2 evidence and network architecture details.

Decision criteria (from our notes) — can you confirm these are accurate / add any thresholds you need?
1) Latency: target p95 end-to-end inference < 150 ms for short-form prompts (50-200 tokens).
2) Cost: target operating cost ~ $150–$300 per 1M tokens (total landed cost) — is that the right ballpark?
3) SLA: availability target 99.95% and SLOs for p95 latency when under expected concurrency (we estimated 1k sustained concurrent requests).
4) Deployment preference: leaning to Dedicated for predictable throughput; Private (VPC/on-prem) only if procurement/legal requires data residency.

Ask: please confirm the economic buyer and primary security/procurement contacts so we can route the right materials and schedule two short follow-ups (security deep-dive + economics/ops). Suggested next steps:
- You share the names/emails for CTO/economic buyer + head of security + procurement contact.
- We send SOC 2 summary, network architecture, and a preliminary TCO estimate for both Dedicated and Private options.
- Schedule 30m tech deep-dive (team: eng + security) and 30m pricing review with your procurement/finance.

I've CC'd Rishi (CS) and Naomi (Security enablement) — they can prep the SOC2 and hosting docs. Attaching: FINOVA_RFP_v2.pdf that you mentioned on the call for our reference.

Available times for next week (PST): Mon 12/08 9–11am, Tue 12/09 1–4pm, Wed 12/10 10–12pm. Let me know what works and who we should invite.

Thanks — Marissa

--

Date: Sat, 06 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Decision criteria & stakeholder mapping — latency/cost/SLA follow-up

Hi Marissa — great summary, thanks. Confirming a few items and adding stakeholders:

- Economic buyer / CTO: Raj Patel (raj.patel@finova.com) — he'll own the final procurement decision.
- Head of Security: Naomi Singh (naomi.singh@finova.com) — she'll run the security questionnaire and technical review.
- Procurement lead: Karen Wu (karen.wu@finova.com) — handles contracting and Po terms.

On the criteria:
- Latency: 150 ms p95 is our aspirational target for the initial rollout; if you can show benchmarks at 95th with our sample prompts that helps.
- Cost: the $150–$300 per 1M tokens is roughly what finance modeled; we need an initial landed TCO for both Dedicated and Private options to compare vs. our current provider.
- SLA: 99.95% is what we expect; also please include MTTR and incident escalation processes for outages.

Procurement timeline: we aim to have vendor shortlists by the end of Q1 2027. Naomi will send an initial security questionnaire (SIG) — can you confirm you have an up-to-date SOC 2 that we can share with procurement?

I'll review the RFP PDF and loop in Raj and Naomi for a short intro meeting. For timing, Tue 12/09 1–2pm PST works for our team.

Thanks,
Alice

Subject: Re: Decision criteria & stakeholder mapping — latency/cost/SLA follow-up

Thanks Alice — appreciate the quick turnaround and the stakeholder list.

Actions from our side:
- Attaching SOC2 summary and hosting overview: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf. It includes scope, last audit date, and where to find the full report under NDA.
- Rishi (CC) will prepare a short TCO estimate (Dedicated vs Private) using the usage assumptions you gave; expect an initial draft by Mon 12/08 EOD.
- Naomi (CC, security enablement) can coordinate the SIG response and schedule a technical security review with Naomi Singh.

About deployment recommendations (short):
- Dedicated: recommended if you want predictable p95 latency and simpler networking (we host in a dedicated GPU pool for your tenant). Lower ops overhead and faster time-to-value.
- Private (VPC/On-prem): recommended if procurement or regulators require customer-managed networking or data residency. Higher setup lead time and potential capex.

Benchmarks and SLOs: we can run a short benchmark with your sample prompts to measure p95 at target concurrency. For an initial estimate, we typically model p95 single-request latencies in the 80–200ms range depending on model choice and prompt length; we'll surface a model-level breakdown in the TCO doc.

Proposed next step: 30m intro + alignment call Tue 12/09 1–2pm PST (as Alice suggested). I'll send an invite after I hear final confirm. If Raj or Naomi want a separate technical security session, we can book a follow-up 45m slot.

Links / docs for reference:
